description: Weekly dependency PRs for the fork, run by the hosted Renovate app (docs/fork.md, 'Dependency updates'). Validate after editing: npx --package renovate@44 -- renovate-config-validator renovate.json

customManagers.description: `# renovate: datasource=… depName=… [registryUrl=…] [extractVersion=…]` directly above `KEY=version`, `ARG KEY=version`, `KEY="version"`, `KEY: version` or an image `KEY="name:tag@sha256:…"`; or `# renovate: datasource=git-refs depName=… packageName=<git url> currentValue=<branch>` above `KEY: <commit>`, which follows the branch head

packageRules.description: Everything not named below: one PR
prBodyNotes: A version with a sha256 pin next to it (Helm in the Dockerfile, kind in e2e-kind.yaml, kwokctl, the Flux controllers and CAPI in hack/e2e-kwok.env) needs its checksums too: run `hack/update-checksums.sh` on this branch and commit the result.

packageRules.description: Go modules other than Kubernetes and Cluster API: one PR. Renovate runs go mod tidy and, since vendor/modules.txt exists, go mod vendor.
Kubernetes and Cluster API: the k8s.io and sigs.k8s.io modules and the CAPI pins of the e2e scripts move together.
prBodyNotes: CAPI_VERSION in hack/e2e-kwok.env has a source checksum: run `hack/update-checksums.sh` on this branch and commit the result.

packageRules.description: Cluster API minors follow the host's CAPI_VERSION (my-turba-env turbacharger/versions.env), by hand: raise this bound with the k8s.io and controller-runtime bounds below. No dependency dashboard (we use no issues), so a bound is the manual approval.
controller-runtime 0.23 and k8s.io 0.35 are what CAPI 1.13 is built on: patches only, minors with a CAPI minor.
kind's node image (hack/e2e-kind.sh) stays on the k8s.io modules' minor (1.35, envtest's in ci.yaml): patches only.
KWOK_KUBE_VERSION: patches only; a minor by hand.
The Go toolchain: go.mod's toolchain line and the Dockerfile's golang tag together, patches only; a Go minor (and go.mod's go line) by hand.
Helm in the image stays on 3: the helm installer drives its CLI; Helm 4 by hand.
The workflows' actions, pinned by SHA with the release in a comment: one PR.
The e2e Flux controllers and vCluster chart follow the host's (my-turba-env turbacharger/versions.env): merge once the host runs the same release.
prBodyNotes: Merge once the host's turbacharger/versions.env has the same release. The Flux controllers have checksums in hack/e2e-kwok.env: run `hack/update-checksums.sh` on this branch and commit the result.
